standard_prerequisites.name: The cosk-sk adjunction
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof line 3430: Mor(X x Delta[n+1], cosk_n sk_n V) = Mor(X x sk_n Delta[n+1], sk_n V).

core_obligations: The representability chain (proof lines 3426-3437): Mor(X x Delta[n+1], cosk_n sk_n V) = Mor(X x sk_n Delta[n+1], sk_n V) = Mor(X x i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], V); hence the left-hand side of the lemma represents the same functor as the object Hom(i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], V)_0, proving the formula by the Yoneda lemma.
The first auxiliary equality (lines 3443-3445): sk_n(X x Delta[n+1]) = X x sk_n Delta[n+1], which the author calls obvious.

The second auxiliary equality (lines 3445-3475): via the internal-hom simplicial set Mor_C(X, W) = ([n] |-> Mor_C(X, W_n)), the identity Mor(U x X, W) = Mor(U, Mor_C(X, W)) for simplicial sets U gives Mor(X x i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], W) = Mor(i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], Mor_C(X, W)) = Mor(sk_n Delta[n+1], sk_n Mor_C(X, W)) = Mor(X x sk_n Delta[n+1], sk_n W) = Mor(i_{n!}(X x sk_n Delta[n+1]), W), proving i_{n!}(X x sk_n Delta[n+1]) = X x i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1].
proof_roadmap: Exhibit both sides as functors in X via the Yoneda lemma.
Chain the cosk-sk adjunction with the commutation of i_{n!} with products.
Prove the two auxiliary commutations, the second through the internal-hom simplicial set.
difficulty_reason: Coskeleton lemma (statement 3418-3428, proof 3430-3475): identifies (cosk_n sk_n V)_{n+1} with the degree-0 part of the mapping object Hom(i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], V) by a Yoneda representability argument; both auxiliary commutations (sk_n with products, i_{n!} with products) are proved in the proof, the second via the internal-hom simplicial set; no verification is omitted. H2: Yoneda bookkeeping with truncation functors.
